headline: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model for agents
body: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model, along with two edge models, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Bolt E4B. NVIDIA says organizations are post-training Super VL for tasks that include credit agreement analysis at Hebbia and financial document intelligence at Ramp.
note: Open weights let a bank post-train a model on its own data and keep it on its own infrastructure, which matters for lenders with data-residency rules. The customer examples are NVIDIA's own account of adoption.

evidence.text: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.

Joining it are two new edge models: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, optimized to balance intelligence and speed per GB for local agentic workloads, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, optimized for intelligence per GB for fast conversational agents.
AfterQuery customized the model for Hebbia for credit agreement analysis.

Additional organizations customizing Nemotron 3.5 Super VL include Ramp for financial document intelligence; Dream , sovereign AI-powered cybersecurity research and vulnerability analysis; Lila Sciences for scientific discovery and search, and R1 for medical claims analysis and revenue cycle management.
Unlike closed frontier models, organizations can post-train Super VL on their own data, deploy it on their own infrastructure and oversee what they build.
Control runs in two directions. Organizations can run the model wherever their security and data-residency requirements dictate.
